mentions.name: cpx
mentions.description: A cargo-like CLI tool for C++ that jumpstarts projects across different build systems (vcpkg, bazel, and meson). Planned features bring CLion-style workflows to the CLI, with Docker-based builds and SSH support exposed through a TUI setup; the Docker side is nearly complete and SSH is in progress.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on cargo like tooling for cpp. It just let you jump start a project for different build systems(vcpkg, bazel and meson). I am also planning to bring CLion features build on docker, ssh to cli with tui setup. Docker side is close to complete working on ssh for now.
